label: Grounding edges from a root compose under the profile classifier
definition: At w, let r be a root and x an existent classified as concrete by the selected profile. If the grounding edges from r to y and from y to x hold at w, with both sources existing at w and satisfying that classifier, the grounding edge from r to x holds at w with the same source guard.
note: Analyst structural condition. It represents root-mediated composition as a direct edge of the supplied grounding relation, rather than merely finite reachability. A directed chain r to y to x without a selected edge from r to x violates it when r is a root and all three are actual concreta. In a graph with all such shortcut edges the condition holds. Whether the selected real grounding or productive relation has this closure remains open. Full transitivity of the actual-concrete graph suffices, and the condition imposes no composition law on pairs whose source is not a root. The concreteness classifier is the supplied m.concrete. An application in the esse-in-re sense would require m.concrete := HasEsseInRe InAct esse or the corresponding equivalence.
